1.overview: With Christmas around the corner, Yuki Nagato and her fellow Literature Club members are planning to hold a Christmas party in the clubroom. One of Yuki’s wishes for the party is to eat turkey, which ends up landing her in a series of weird competitions.

2.overview: Christmas is here and it’s party time for the Literature Club! Yuki looks back at how she was able to save the club and feels very happy that her wishes have come true. Now, there’s only one thing left for her to accomplish on this day...

3.overview: The day after the Christmas party, Nagato and Kyon encounter a girl who falls down in front of a park. After helping her to a warm place, they’re told that she was trying to capture Santa in the park, which makes Nagato remember that she’s met her before.

4.overview: The day before Valentine’s Day, the Literature Club is holding no activities. While Haruhi drags Kyon around for her own activities, Nagato makes a Valentine gift to give to Kyon with Asakura's help. But can she muster the courage to actually give it to him?

5.overview: On Valentine’s Day, Nagato rushes out of the clubroom when she walks in on Haruhi giving chocolates to Kyon. After seeing how Nagato left, Asakura starts worrying that Nagato might have given up on giving chocolates to Kyon.

6.overview: When Haruhi and Koizumi see Kyon working on his schoolwork, they realize that he’s studying what they learned last year. When Haruhi mentions it, Kyon feels like she’s taking North High lightly and gets Ryoko to uphold their honor with a math challenge.

7.overview: Although Ryoko gets increasingly worried about Yuki’s relationship with Kyon after seeing what happened in the clubroom, she realizes that all she can do is watch over her. Meanwhile, the gang leaves for a hot spring to hold their training camp.

11.overview: As Ryoko suspected, Yuki IS different from who she used to be. While Ryoko and Kyon are worried that Yuki might behave so differently that their classmates may figure it out, she plays the role of the old Yuki just fine and no one notices anything.

12.overview: Kyon and Yuki visit the library in order to study for their final exams. Although Kyon was hoping to get Yuki’s help with his studying, she becomes so fixated on books that she ends up forgetting why they are there in the first place.

title.ja: 長門有希ちゃんの消失III
title.en: The Disappearance of Nagato Yuki-chan III

13.overview: Yuki keeps having a dream in which she gazes into the memories of her other self and starts realizing that the time for her to go back to her other self might be approaching.
13.summary:
Yuki keeps having a dream in which she gazes into the memories of her other self and starts realizing that the time for her to go back to her other self might be approaching.
Source: crunchyroll

14.overview: After Yuki goes back to being her old self, the lives of the North High’s Literature Club members are also going back to normal, except for Kyon, who doesn’t know how to deal with the old Yuki due to the knowledge of the other Yuki’s feelings towards him.
14.summary: Yuki has reverted to her original personality and does not consciously remember much of what her other persona said and did, particularly the fact that she confessed her love to Kyon. Kyon however remembers this all too clearly and is as a result very awkward to her. Haruhi and Koizumi visit the Literature Club again, and press Kyon into helping find a nice bamboo sapling to use for hanging written wishes as it is July 7, the Tanabata festival. Haruhi remembers that she met Kyon long ago, as he helped her produce her "message to the aliens", though he has forgotten about this himself.

15.overview: The summer break is finally here. North High’s Literature Club sets out to vacation at the Tsuruya family’s summer house on the beach. Can Yuki spend time alone with Kyon? Will Kyon be able to get over his awkward feelings towards Yuki?
15.summary: It is summer vacation, and Haruhi and Tsuruya have prepared an outing to the beach and the mountains for the Literature Club. Kyon`s little sister joins the seven of them on the trip. Kyon continues to feel very awkward to Yuki through most of the excursion, despite Ryoko`s and Tsuruya`s efforts to bring them together, until the test of courage where they are paired. They make their way to a mountain lake with many fireflies flying about, without realising that they have been holding hands in a rather romantic fashion.

16.overview: The summer is almost over. Ever since the other Yuki disappeared, Kyon has been acting strange around Yuki. When he realizes that it’s not just him who’s feeling awkward and that he’s making Yuki suffer, he decides to do something about it.
16.summary: Summer vacation continues, and Haruhi has many activities lined up for the club when she meets with them at a café. It rains and Yuki shares an umbrella with Kyon. Over the next several days Haruhi has them doing batting practice, bowling, and so forth. Kyon continues to be awkward, until the summer festival. He comments to Ryoko that he must seem very indecisive, and she agrees and says that the current Yuki must be wondering why he is keeping his distance. As the festival fireworks start, Kyon decides to take Yuki aside, pulling her along, until he reaches a secluded spot. Yuki can`t hear what he`s saying amid the fireworks, but the other Yuki hears him as he confesses that he would have fallen in love with her too. Haruhi seems to be discontented by what Kyon and Yuki seem to be doing. Kyon, having said what he had to say, begins to treat Yuki normally again.
